```{r}
#| label: setup-libraries-and-config

source("helpers_qc.R")

# Carica la configurazione YAML
all_configs <- yaml::read_yaml("configs/datasets.yaml")
curr_cfg    <- all_configs[[params$dataset]]

# Carica i dati e standardizza la colonna identificativa delle cellule
sce <- readRDS(curr_cfg$sce_path)
colData(sce)$cell_id <- colData(sce)[[curr_cfg$cell_id_col]]
```
